TF-IDF

Source: R/count.R
tf_idf.Rd

Term frequency-inverse document frequency of every term in every document, or in every group when by names a grouping column (each group is then treated as one document).

Usage

tf_idf(tokens, by = "doc_id")

Arguments

tokens

A token table from tokenize_ko() (doc_id, token).

by

Column that defines a document. Defaults to "doc_id".

Value

A tibble with by, token, n, tf, idf and tf_idf, sorted by tf_idf.

Details

tf is the term count divided by the total count in the document and idf is log(number of documents / documents containing the term).

Examples

tokens <- tokenize_ko(as_news(president_lee_2026_08), keep = "source")
#> Detected columns: doc_id <- `뉴스 식별자`, date <- `일자`, source <- `언론사`, title <- `제목`, keyword <- `키워드`
tf_idf(tokens)
